title: crew-factory manifest .claude/crews/<lang>.json
$comment: Machine schema for the crew manifest crew-factory writes and team-sprint phase-0 step 10a consumes. scripts/crew_check.sh validate_manifest checks these constraints in pure jq on every `check`/`verify` call; this file is the human-readable statement of the same shape. The `skills` map is optional (older manifests predate it); `accessibility` is omitted from `crew` for non-frontend stacks and `boundary_reviewer` is provenance-only — no consumer resolves it.
